covers.note: DX/standard and alternate chart IDs may share a song jacket; canonical song IDs are used for fallback.

current.note: 11 unmodified PNGs served publicly by the official mainland Wahlap maimai DX website. All have the DX RATING label; no Japanese lettering or drawn replacement. Five number glyphs overlaid separately.

rating.legacy: Japanese frames, homemade adaptations and the Lxns gradient badge are no longer rendered.

plates.note: Exact song, chart type and difficulty requirements from public API, including required ReMASTER charts. Missing charts never unlock an award. Stamp and regional unlocks adapted to simulator; no travel companions.

notice: Unofficial fan simulator. Game art belongs to its respective rights holders. No official audio or playable chart files are included.

titles.note: Awakening titles removed. Movement titles use actual simulated outbound/return arcade kilometers with original thresholds; machine-readable song/rating requirements implemented. Unsupported sync and event conditions remain locked.

techniqueTags.note: Matches title, SD/DX and difficulty. Community technique tags take priority; note-ratio estimation is an explicit fallback. Technical tags are hidden from queries/details and drive original simulated segment checks; no chart timing data is claimed.

judgements.note: Scoring fractions cross-checked against the MIT-licensed project's calculator. Random judgement probabilities are original simulator design.

b50.note: Original canvas renderer, five columns, B35/B15, local jackets and existing simulator palette. Offline data-URL jacket resources support PNG export from file URLs.

worldEncyclopedia.partners: Four official SEGA area character icons transformed into pixel art for this unofficial fan game.
worldEncyclopedia.birds: Four Wikimedia Commons photographs, cropped and transformed into pixel art; per-file author and Creative Commons license are recorded in the manifest.
